0x5f6c7a5.rule: group 0 has exactly one element -> scalar tail

0x5f6c810.rule: arg2 count > group 0 count -> threshold branch

0x5f6c84c.rule: count > new level (signed) -> next-group double-math block

0x5f6c86e.rule: previous group sum == 0 -> compute current group sum

0x5f6c877.rule: level != starting level -> skip cache add

0x5f6c87e.rule: level == starting level and flag live -> cache += group sum

0x5f6c9f8.rule: next-group sum == 0 -> loop bottom, no cache add

0x5f6caf7.rule: group 0 sum >= threshold (unsigned) -> proceed, flag live

cache_rules: flag set at entry: cache = 0, return
otherwise cache = group 0 sum, or 0 when the threshold branch clears the flag
first iteration only, when level == starting level and flag live: cache += current group sum
qualifying next-group step with nonzero sum: cache += unsigned_double_to_int64((g / acc + 1.0) * remainder)

0x5f6c88e.role: index-leaf call with the pre-increment level

fields.arg2+0x70: signed 32-bit count compared against group 0 element count
fields.arg2+0xa0: threshold qword compared unsigned against the group 0 sum
fields.element+0x10: qword summed per group element, wrapping mod 2**64
fields.obj+0x18: index-array base pointer (one qword per level)
fields.obj+0xa90: flag byte; when set, cache = 0 and the pass returns
fields.obj+0xa98: base pointer of 24-byte group records (begin, end, third never read)
fields.obj+0xfc8: cached total qword, written by the pass

not_modelled: bytes at 0x5f6cb28 and after: outside the main FDE range, not part of this pass
the divide-by-zero arm of the double-math block: unreachable, since index < acc implies acc > 0 except for a wrapping case that cannot take the branch
the tail-jump caller's use of obj+0xfc8 after the pass returns

helper.role: loop gate: 0 when obj+0xa90 set, else signed32(obj+0x10) - 2

main.role: double-accumulation pass; returns void; writes obj+0xfc8
